locations.name: Frozen Tundra
locations.brief: A harsh, frozen tundra where the story opens.
locations.description: A snow-covered, windswept tundra under a flat, colorless sky; the wind carries stinging grains of ice.
locations.current_state: Cold and windswept; snow is settling into exposed clothing.

locations.name: Dark Rock Rise
locations.brief: A low, broken rise of dark rock to the west on the frozen tundra.
locations.description: A low, broken rise of dark rock to the west of the Time Traveler's position; he crossed it at a stumble and from its crest saw the mammoth carcass lying in the white beyond.
locations.current_state: Crossed by the Time Traveler; on its far side lie the dead mammoth and the ravine.

locations.name: The Ravine
locations.brief: A ravine beyond the rise, first seen from the tundra as a shadow.
locations.description: A ravine beyond the rise of dark rock; from the tundra it appeared only as a shadow that might have been a ravine.

entities.name: The Jump
entities.brief: The time jump whose afterimage and nausea the Time Traveler experienced on waking.
entities.description: The time-travel jump that left an afterimage behind the Time Traveler's eyes and nausea rolling through him in thin waves.

entities.name: The Time Traveler's Coat
entities.brief: A coat worn by the Time Traveler on the frozen tundra.
entities.description: A coat whose folds and seams are filling with settling snow.
entities.current_state: Snow is settling into its folds and seams.

entities.name: The Woolly Mammoth Carcass
entities.brief: A whole, unmarked woolly mammoth lying dead in the snow beyond the rise.
entities.description: A dark mound in the white, too regular to be rock; snow had drifted against one flank and the matted coat held the animal's shape like a cast. Its trunk lay curled against the snow and one tusk was sheared near the root. The body was whole, with no cuts, no spear marks and no trampled ring where hunters had stood; nothing had fed on it. It had lain down, or been caught, and the cold had kept it.
entities.current_state: Dead and preserved by the cold; a rib shard and a strip of hide have been taken from it.

entities.name: Rib Shard and Hide Strip
entities.brief: A shard of mammoth rib and a board-stiff strip of hide taken from the carcass by the Time Traveler.
entities.description: A shard of rib worked free from the mammoth carcass, and a strip of hide torn from its flank, stiff as board. The hide is wrapped around the Time Traveler's wrist; the bone is carried in his coat.
entities.current_state: Carried by the Time Traveler: hide wrapped around his wrist, rib shard in his coat.

items.brief: A male time traveler stranded far earlier than his intended era on the frozen tundra, cold and scavenging what he can from a dead mammoth.

items.name: The Time Traveler
items.brief: A male time traveler stranded far earlier than his intended era on the frozen tundra, cold and scavenging what he can from a dead mammoth.

state.current_goal: To reach the ravine beyond the rise.

knowledge.content: The cold can progress from shivering to numbness to a sleep that does not end, and he has hours or perhaps fewer.
A low, broken rise of dark rock lies to the west, with a shadow beyond it that might be a ravine.
A woolly mammoth lies dead beyond the rise: whole, with one tusk sheared near the root, no cuts, no spear marks, no trampled hunter's ring, and nothing had fed on it; the cold preserved it.
knowledge.acquired_via: Crossing the rise and examining the carcass.

knowledge.content: He aimed for the late Pleistocene—the caves, the fires, the people he had spent his life studying—but arrived somewhere tens of thousands of years older; the jump missed, or he did, and the error is not one he can walk back from.
knowledge.acquired_via: Reasoning from the mammoth carcass and the landscape.

beliefs: He wonders whether dedicating everything in his life to his goal was worth it.
He had given everything to arrive, and here there is only a dead thing in the snow and no one to meet him.
